example-repo-a1b2c3._note: Upstream CI (.github/workflows/test.yml) installs redis-server and runs `go test -p 1 ./...`; TestResolveDNS needs DNS and is skipped offline.
example-repo-a1b2c3.install_block:
RUN go mod download
# Debian 12 version resolved inside mars-base on 2026-09-15
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends redis-server=5:7.0.15-1~deb12u9 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Skipped offline: TestResolveDNS resolves a public hostname (no DNS inside the delivery container)

smoke.native: { redis-server --daemonize yes && go test -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 30m ./... -skip '^TestResolveDNS$'; } > /tmp/gotest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^(FAIL|--- FAIL|panic)' /tmp/gotest.log | head -n 30; tail -n 8 /tmp/gotest.log; exit $rc
